instruction.name: vextrins.w
instruction.description: Copy the 32-bit element of `b` selected by `imm[1:0]` into the element of `a` selected by `imm[5:4]`; other elements remain unchanged.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 1.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vextrins.w $vr0, $vr8, 1; vextrins.w $vr1, $vr9, 1; vextrins.w $vr2, $vr10, 1; vextrins.w $vr3, $vr11, 1; vextrins.w $vr4, $vr12, 1; vextrins.w $vr5, $vr13, 1; vextrins.w $vr6, $vr14, 1; vextrins.w $vr7, $vr15, 1
